title: Noise average of a Gaussian indicator
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$, and let $\theta\in[0,\pi]$. For $x\in\mathbb R^n$, the Gaussian noise operator with correlation $\cos\theta$ applied to the indicator of $A$ equals
\[\int_{\mathbb R^n}1_A(\cos\theta\,x+\sin\theta\,y)\,d\gamma_n(y),\]
where $\gamma_n$ is standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$.
